name: tdd
description: Vertical-slice red-green-refactor TDD at pre-agreed public seams with hermetic offline testing boundaries. Prevents implementation-coupled mocks, tautological assertions, and horizontal test slicing.
suggestedPrompts: Build this feature using vertical-slice TDD—propose the seams to test first
Fix this bug test-first at the real public seam with a hermetic regression test
Audit these tests for implementation-coupled mocks or tautological assertions
